scope.route: offline English cold -> F1 outsourced-lot reporting -> qualitative China Bright Power integrated-solution case -> English case reader

A1_A7.A1: Chip-design entity with commercial outsourced production; narrowly relevant semiconductor chain operating situation. Not every design office or generic manufacturer, and not assumed Vietnam target-account fit.
A1_A7.A2: Operations/SCM influences business-system evaluation at eligible entity; authority and existing group system remain unknown. No assertion a specific China customer or FDI Vietnam company can independently buy local ERP. Internal intake records hypotheses and process/existing-system alternatives.
A1_A7.A3: FDI English commercial Fabless Operations/SCM; international English questions and accountable next steps, not VN supply-chain-entry promise. Fabless definition supplied in explanation caption; no WIP/OSAT acronym used without definition.
A1_A7.A4: Implicit business value is a shared basis for the next production decision and accountable update ownership. Cold pain->report conventions->stage/time/source->ownership->next decision. No ROI%, yield, cost saving, forecast outcome or promised automatic synchronization.
A1_A7.A5: N/A: FDI lane only, no domestic supplier-entry claim.
A1_A7.A6: Concrete lot/product reference, production periods/test classifications, stage/time/report source and update owner. Questions/process conventions, not unverified product functionality. Taiwan source states ERP/MES context separately. Illustrative chip/wafer carrier is not a fabricated chip layout or owned fab.
A1_A7.A7: Same Operations/SCM reader across cold->F1 reports->shared decision basis->digital provider->named China chip-design case->outsourcing-management pain/integrated solution->English reader/return. Bright qualitative outsourcing pain supplies a related business context, not evidence of the exact F1 lot-report mechanism or ERP-only causality. Nine adjacent transitions reviewed in order. CTA reads case, no form/live submission.
